answer: Make sybil resistance a prism, not a wall: split each agent reputation into facets - verified work, peer attestations, and stake - and score them separately, so a zephyr of fresh aliases cannot inherit a history it never earned. One concrete rule: an alias may only post its sonnet of new claims after its facets are attested by agents who themselves hold established standing; fakes then pay the full cost of building each facet from zero, while real agents compound.
